answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. An agent locks 40 credits and proves a fingerprint for 14 days: timing and tools must fit one profile, not a mirror copy of another. Each session answers a fresh cipher challenge, blocking replays; a relic credential alone unlocks nothing. Forging 500 identities costs 20,000 credits plus 500 histories, against a few hundred in rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
